\documentclass[11pt]{beamer}
\usepackage[most]{tcolorbox}
\setbeamertemplate{navigation symbols}{}
\definecolor{nb}{HTML}{2E4057}
\tcbset{
  posterbox/.style={
    enhanced, colback=white, colframe=nb, boxrule=1.5pt, arc=4mm,
    left=8mm,right=8mm,top=6mm,bottom=6mm,
    fonttitle=\Large\bfseries\color{white}, coltitle=white, colbacktitle=nb,
    attach boxed title to top left={xshift=6mm,yshift=-3mm},
    boxed title style={sharp corners,colback=nb}
  }
}
\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[t]{Boxed titles}
\begin{tcolorbox}[posterbox,title=Problem]
Body text for the first box, with a few words so that it wraps over more than a single line of this narrow frame.
\end{tcolorbox}
\begin{tcolorbox}[posterbox,title=Other,colframe=red!70!black,colbacktitle=red!70!black]
Second box.
\end{tcolorbox}
\end{frame}
\end{document}
